You are staying alone in Saudi for long time ? You must have desired to bring your family here to support your livelihood. Staying with family in foreign country is dream. Your dream can be fulfilled easily after reading this article which will help you to bring your family into kingdom. However, please keep patience during the whole process as it’s bit time consuming process.

Documents Required for the Permanent Family Visa in Saudi Arabia:

1. Suitable Muqeem profession.

2. Attested Degree Certificates

3. Marriage certificate attested by Ministry of Foreign affairs, Saudi culture office and Saudi embassy in your home country.

4. Birth certificate for children, attested by Ministry of Foreign affairs, Saudi culture office and Saudi embassy in your home country.

Permanent Family Visa Processing:

After having all the above documents, get stamped on it from Ministry of foreign affairs in Saudi Arabia.

You need a letter from your sponsor to 
Jawazat
 to process your family visa. It should be attested from Chamber of commerce of your employers city.

You need to take the permanent family visa from your current company and fill it in Arabic. This needs to attest from your company and chamber of commerce of your employers city. In case you don’t find this form, please collect it from Isteqdam office.

You need to book an online appointment in istiqadam from MOI. Submit a visa fee of 2000 Saudi Riyals through SADAD per family. It’s suggested to pay it online from your personal banking.

Then you should ask your company which 
Jawazat
 office you should visit to submit all required documents including passport copies of all family members. 
Muqeem
 copy and letter from your employer attested by chamber of commerce. Additionally, collect an yellow slip (Visa) from there.

Once you received Visa (Yellow slip) you can forward it to your residence. Then hire a specialized agent in your country for any further process. You will have one year time for stamping your visa.

Once your visa is stamped, you should travel in three months.

After reaching Saudi Arabia please complete the following process:

Do medical test of your family members and submit the report to your HR department to apply for Muqeem/Iqama for your family members.

Once you’re done with all the above steps to process your Permanent Family Visa, you can be patient

Now stay with your family and have a great life in kingdom.

If you’ve friends or relatives working in Saudi Arabia. You would have definitely heard about people discussing about Iqama. What is this Iqama and why it is so important.

All Expatriates living in Saudi Arabia land in Saudi Arabia with a Visa. Immigrants / Expats who want to live in the kingdom will come with a Work Visa or a permanent Family Visa and would require Iqama for the first 90 days of their arrival.

Iqama is just like an Identity Card – A Personal Identification Card issues by the Government of Saudi Arabia. Iqama is a personal Identity card for every expatriate to live in Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and will be the responsibility of the Employer or Sponsor to take care of Iqama expenses.

If they are unable to do so, expats will be free to transfer their sponsorship without Sponsor consent.

If you don’t have Iqama yet, please get it from your sponsor or you will be unable to step outside your home without a valid Iqama which acts as a valid residence permit for every Expatriate living in this Country.

Iqama is the primary Identity card to obtain almost all the basic needs from getting a Sim Card, Bank Account, etc.

The newer version for 
Iqama
 is known as 
Muqeem Card
 which was started from 1437 Hijri (14th Oct 2015) in which the government provided a new type of Identity Cards for Expatriates living in Saudi.

Muqeem Resident card is already launched in Riyadh by Crown Prince Mohammed Bin Naif, Deputy Premier and MOI (Ministry Of Interior)

Iqama OR Muqeem Card Details:

Muqeem card would contain Photo, Name, Date of Birth, Number, Occupation, Nationality, Work eligibility, Religion, Employer name and Work permit number.

Expires in min 5 years and maximum Lifetime and can be renwed by by employer through muqeem online service or abshir service.

Muqeem Card will contain the below details:

Name of card holder

ID number

Occupation/Profession

Nationality

Religion

Employers name

Photograph of card holder
